title: Felix and the Promise
author: Yara Ashgrove
blurb: Rafael Okonkwo, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then two estranged names appear on the same impossibly stubborn orchard deed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
